description: This file defines the Drupal TwigExtension class, which provides Drupal-specific extensions to Twig, including functions, filters, node visitors, and URL generation methods.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Template\TwigExtension
classes.description: Provides Drupal-specific Twig extensions including functions, filters, and URL helpers.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig functions provided by this extension.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig filters provided by this extension.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns node visitors for Twig parsing.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns token parsers for Twig.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the Twig extension.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Generates a URL path given a route name and parameters.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Generates an absolute URL given a route name and parameters.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns a render array for a link to a URL.

methods.name: getFileUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for a given file URI.

methods.name: getActiveTheme
methods.description: Returns the name of the active theme.

methods.name: getActiveThemePath
methods.description: Returns the path of the active theme.

methods.name: isUrlGenerationSafe
methods.description: Determines if URL generation will be safe based on arguments.

methods.name: attachLibrary
methods.description: Attaches an asset library to the template.

methods.name: escapePlaceholder
methods.description: Wraps escapeFilter to produce a placeholder.

methods.name: escapeFilter
methods.description: Overrides Twig's escape filter with Drupal's implementation.

methods.name: bubbleArgMetadata
methods.description: Bubbles cacheability and attachment metadata for Twig arguments.

methods.name: renderVar
methods.description: Renders a variable, object, or render array for Twig output.

methods.name: safeJoin
methods.description: Joins multiple strings safely with escaping.

methods.name: createAttribute
methods.description: Creates an Attribute object from array or existing object.

methods.name: withoutFilter
methods.description: Removes specified child elements from a render array.

methods.name: suggestThemeHook
methods.description: Adds a theme suggestion to a render array.

methods.name: checkDeprecations
methods.description: Triggers deprecation warnings for deprecated variables.

methods.name: addClass
methods.description: Adds CSS classes to a render element.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute on a render element.
